# ankra_organisation_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists the records in the organisation's DNS zone, including those clusters publish. The counterpart of `ankra org dns list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_organisation_dns_records" "all" {}

output "record_names" {
  value = data.ankra_organisation_dns_records.all.records[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `records` (Attributes List) Records in the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String) What the record points at.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the record.
- `name` (String) Full name of the record.
- `record_type` (String) Record type.
- `state` (String) `pending`, `active`, `deleting` or `failed`.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds; null is Auto.
